region: Hammondsport · Keuka Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Living Roots Wine & Co. was founded in 2016 by Sebastian and Colleen Hardy, a sixth-generation South Australian winemaker and a Rochester-area native who met working a vintage in Australia. They began with Rochester’s only urban winery and later, as the business outgrew it, built a production winery and tasting room on Colleen’s family’s Shale Creek Vineyard overlooking Keuka Lake near Hammondsport, where they source many of their grapes. They also make reds in the Adelaide Hills, and Halliday’s Wine Companion named them Australia’s Best New Winery in 2023.

Ramato, from the Italian rame, “copper”, is a historic style from Friuli in north-eastern Italy. Pinot Grigio (Pinot Gris) has greyish-pink skins, and when the juice is left in contact with them, instead of being pressed straight off as for a white wine, it takes on a coppery colour along with extra texture and grip. A short maceration gives a fresh, peach-tinted wine; a longer one gives a deeper, amber, more autumnal style. Living Roots’ version applies the idea to Finger Lakes Pinot Gris from the cool 2024 vintage.

Expect something between a white and a light red in feel: it shows blood orange, apricot and grapefruit peel, white tea and dried rose petals, with pear skin and fresh herbs adding the gentle savoury edge that skin contact brings. Skin contact is a recurring theme at Living Roots: its Session Gold macerates Cayuga White on Aromella skins and Vidal on Traminette skins, and its Red Rizza ferments Riesling on Cabernet Franc skins.
